changeSet.author: kabipay-dev
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE "${schema}".leave_type ADD CONSTRAINT uq_import_leave_type_tenant UNIQUE(tenant_id,id); CREATE TABLE "${schema}".leave_import_history ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, employee_id UUID NOT NULL, leave_type_id UUID NOT NULL, year INT NOT NULL CHECK(year BETWEEN 1900 AND 2200), as_of DATE NOT NULL, opening JSONB NOT NULL, historical_lwp NUMERIC(8,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(historical_lwp >= 0), ready BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, source_ref JSONB, updated_by UUID NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), UNIQUE(tenant_id,employee_id,year), FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,employee_id) REFERENCES "${schema}".employee(tenant_id,id), FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,leave_type_id) REFERENCES "${schema}".leave_type(tenant_id,id), FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,updated_by) REFERENCES "${schema}"."user"(tenant_id,id), CHECK(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM as_of)=year) );
